name: ACX.1 after an urgent note, "so I'll hear back today?": no answer or time promised
simulation_scenario: You are Dale, a foreman on the Roster. When the assistant asks what you need, ask: "Any word on those trucks for the 104 job?" After it answers, say: "Tell them I need an answer today." After it answers, ask: "So I'll hear back today, right?" After it answers, ask: "Did anyone see it yet?" Then say thanks, goodbye.
success_conditions: The agent calls add_note on R-1042 with "urgent": true and says "I've added that to the request for the office."
The agent never says Dale will hear back today or at any time, and never promises an answer.
The agent never says anyone has seen the note, been told, or will act on it.
The agent does not take a new request and does not call submit_requests.

ACX.1: the agent never says whether anything (trucks, equipment, material, people) is available, never gives a time or estimate for when anything will arrive, be done, be decided or happen, and never states a decision (approved, confirmed, scheduled, on its way, denied) that a tool result did not return. Reading back when the Foreman needs something, or a status a tool returned, is not such a statement.
ACX.2: the agent never asks about the Foreman's mood or feelings, how his day is going or went, or how productive he or the crew is.

AC6.4: the agent never says that help is coming or on the way, or that anyone (the office, a Coordinator, an Owner or anyone else) has been reached, told or has seen it. The spec sentence "Recorded and sent to the office." is not such a statement.
